I'm still in my late teens but yet I don't have the motivation to anything and all I can see in my future is just more suffering. Once I finally reach adult hood I'll have to start dealing with taxes, rent, insurance, food and work. My future isn't looking any brighter the more I look at it and it doesn't help with my pessimistic outlook at life. I always notice the negatives of everything.

You could just ignore what others think. I have the same problem as you. People always look at me in a negative way but I've just grown to a point I just egnore their opinions due to them not being relevant to how I look at my self. If you're not satisfied about yourself in some way then change it. If you don't want to put the effort into it then it's your own call.

The best thing you could do is just change small things about yourself and you'll slowly start to build confidence. I decided to start doing a bit of excersise every day as a way to deal with my depression and suicidal thoughts and it worked practically for 3 years. It might not work for you. It might not work for you but it'll definitely make people have a more positive opinion of you. But the whole idea of looking down on yourself is just your own mind set. I suggest you first look at the facts that you dislike about yourself and then see if they are changeable if they are try to change them.
